title: China's Xi welcomes Marcos, First Lady Liza as leaders gather for APEC
summary: SHENZHEN -- President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. and First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos were given an official welcome by Chinese President Xi Jinping and First Lady Peng Liyuan on Wednesday evening…

blocks.text: SHENZHEN — President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. and First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos were given an official welcome by Chinese President Xi Jinping and First Lady Peng Liyuan on Wednesday evening in this city for the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting.
Marcos and First Lady Liza joined their fellow leaders and spouses tonight for a gala dinner and cultural presentation.
Marcos and his entire delegation arrived in China at 5:30 p.m. today.
The APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting will be held from November 18 to 19, preceded by an annual summit of CEOs on November 17 to 18.
APEC is a regional forum of 21 member economies in the Asia-Pacific. The theme of this year's summit is "Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together." –NB, GMA News
